articles.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
articles.abstract: We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution evidence into tasks and evaluation rubrics for continual learning. At its core is recursive-in-recursive self-improvement, a paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning: the inner recursion improves the harness with the model fixed, while the outer recursion trains the model under the improved harness. Harness evolution shapes training experience, and model learning creates new opportunities for harness adaptation. We present case studies of researcher interaction, harness refinement, and model learning, with the benchmark cases spanning four scientific task families. By releasing ScienceBuddy as a research product, we make this paradigm available to the scientific community and take a step toward discovery intelligence: scientific AI that advances through sustained collaboration with researchers and evolves alongside the research it supports. Website: http://science-buddy.io
articles.titleCn: 科学伙伴：递归式自我改进的交互式科学代理
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍并发布了ScienceBuddy，一个交互式科学研究工作空间，它将不断改进的科学智能体引入研究人员的日常工作中。ScienceBuddy支持研究人员执行科学任务，同时将他们的请求、反馈和执行证据转化为用于持续学习的任务和评估标准。其核心是递归中的递归自我改进，这是一种结合了利用进化与模型强化学习的范式：内部递归在固定模型的情况下改进利用，而外部递归在改进的利用下训练模型。利用进化塑造了训练体验，模型学习为利用适应创造了新的机会。我们展示了研究人员交互、利用精炼和模型学习的案例研究，基准案例涵盖了四个科学任务家族。通过将ScienceBuddy作为研究产品发布，我们将这一范式提供给科学界，并迈向发现智能的一步：一种通过与研究人员的持续合作而进步、并与其支持的研究共同演变的科学人工智能。网站：http://science-buddy.io

articles.title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control
articles.abstract: Large language models can produce fluent answers when their factual support is weak. This paper introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework that makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of the information required to answer a question. We evaluate three CoSQ variants under seventeen conditions on the 817-item TruthfulQA multiple-choice validation set using eleven open-weight and hosted model families. In the final balanced-option protocol, Grounded-CoSQ at τ=0.90 reduces the mean unconditional wrong-commitment rate from 13.1% under chain-of-thought prompting to 8.9%, a 32.1% relative reduction, while increasing answered accuracy from 86.9% to 89.7% and answering 87.6% of questions. Both improvements hold for all eleven models and at every evaluated threshold. Critical-CoSQ and Adaptive-CoSQ provide neighboring operating points with 88.6% and 86.5% coverage, respectively, while remaining more reliable than the baseline. A secondary Natural Questions Short-Answer evaluation provides convergent open-form evidence. These findings show that self-assessment can support explicit, tunable answer-or-abstain decisions when an unsupported commitment is more costly than referral or review.
articles.titleCn: 当LLMs应该保持沉默？基于自我提问的链式选择性风险控制
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在事实依据薄弱时仍能生成流畅的回答。本文介绍了自我提问链（CoSQ），这是一种仅通过提示框架，使回答承诺取决于对回答问题所需信息的明确评估。我们使用十一组开放权重和托管模型，在817项TruthfulQA多项选择题验证集的十七个条件下评估了三种CoSQ变体。在最终的平衡选项协议中，当τ=0.90时，Grounded-CoSQ将无条件的错误承诺率从思维链提示下的13.1%降低至8.9%，相对降低了32.1%，同时将回答准确率从86.9%提高到89.7%，并回答了87.6%的问题。这两个改进适用于所有十一种模型和每个评估阈值。Critical-CoSQ和Adaptive-CoSQ分别提供了88.6%和86.5%的覆盖率，同时比基线更可靠。一个次要的Natural Questions短答案评估提供了收敛的开放式证据。这些结果表明，自我评估可以在不支持承诺的成本高于转介或审查时，支持明确、可调节的回答或放弃决策。

articles.title: What Breaks Under Pruning in Smart Homes, and When? Evaluating LLM Degradation Across Architectures and Task Complexity
articles.abstract: Pruning can reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), but its impact on context-grounded tool calling remains poorly understood. We systematically study pruning-induced degradation in smart-home tool calling across four LLMs spanning dense Transformer, dense hybrid, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, together with depth, width, hybrid, and expert pruning methods. After post-pruning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we evaluate more than 19,500 instances from three smart-home datasets. Beyond aggregate task accuracy, we characterize degradation along two dimensions: action components (i.e., operation, device, argument, and value) and task complexity. Our results show that dense models have narrow safe pruning regions followed by sharp degradation, while MoE models tolerate substantially more pruning. Pruning degrades grounded specificity before schema-level intent, and aggressive dense pruning can induce systematic over-refusal. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating pruning beyond aggregate accuracy when selecting pruned LLMs for reliable tool execution.
articles.titleCn: 修剪时智能家居中哪些功能会中断以及何时？评估不同架构和任务复杂度下大型语言模型的性能下降
articles.abstractCn: 剪枝可以降低大型语言模型（LLM）的部署成本，但其对基于上下文的工具调用的影响仍不明确。我们系统地研究了在四种LLM（涵盖密集Transformer、密集混合和专家混合MoE架构）中，针对深度、宽度、混合和专家剪枝方法，剪枝引起的智能家庭工具调用退化问题。在剪枝后的监督微调（SFT）后，我们评估了来自三个智能家庭数据集的超过19,500个实例。除了总体任务准确率外，我们还从两个维度（动作组件，即操作、设备、参数和值，以及任务复杂度）来描述退化情况。结果表明，密集模型具有狭窄的安全剪枝区域，随后急剧退化，而MoE模型能容忍更多的剪枝。剪枝会先降低基于上下文的特定性，然后影响模式级的意图，并且激进的密集剪枝可能引发系统性的过度拒绝。这些发现强调了在选择用于可靠工具执行的剪枝LLM时，除了总体准确率外，评估剪枝的重要性。

articles.title: LACE: Layer-Wise Compression for Dynamic Frame Rate Codecs
articles.abstract: Neural audio codecs are a key component in speech language modeling. However, their high frame rates lead to long sequence lengths, increasing computational costs. Dynamic frame rate codecs mitigate this by reducing the effective frame rate using a compression step to merge multiple frames together. However, most prior methods either operate on single-codebook codecs or apply a single compression step before multi-layer quantization. This forces all quantization layers to share the same segmentation boundaries, despite the residual embeddings at different quantization layers exhibiting different rates of change over time. We propose LACE (Layer-Adaptive Codec Encoding), a dynamic frame rate codec that applies an independent compression step at each quantization layer, enabling layer-specific segmentation boundaries. To use LACE tokens in downstream text-to-speech (TTS), we further introduce union alignment and boundary anchor mechanisms to make durations consistent across layers while preserving compression benefits. Experiments on LibriTTS show that LACE offers a better rate-quality tradeoff than prior dynamic frame rate methods on the reconstruction task and improves TTS inference efficiency while maintaining competitive synthesis quality. Our code is released as part of the ESPnet3 codec recipe.
articles.titleCn: LACE：动态帧率编解码器的逐层压缩
articles.abstractCn: 神经音频编解码器是语音语言建模的关键组成部分。然而，它们的高帧率会导致序列长度过长，增加计算成本。动态帧率编解码器通过压缩步骤合并多个帧来降低有效帧率，从而缓解这一问题。然而，大多数现有方法要么在单码本编解码器上运行，要么在多层量化之前应用单一压缩步骤。这迫使所有量化层共享相同的分割边界，尽管不同量化层的残差嵌入在时间上的变化速率不同。我们提出了LACE（层自适应编解码器编码），一种动态帧率编解码器，它在每一层量化步骤中应用独立的压缩步骤，从而实现层特定的分割边界。为了在下游文本到语音（TTS）中使用LACE token，我们进一步引入了联合对齐和边界锚定机制，以使各层之间的时长相一致，同时保留压缩优势。在LibriTTS上的实验表明，LACE在重建任务上比现有的动态帧率方法提供了更好的率-质量权衡，并在保持具有竞争力的合成质量的同时提高了TTS推理效率。我们的代码作为ESPnet3编解码器配方的一部分发布。

articles.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
articles.abstract: LLM assistants are widely used for daily social advice, yet evaluating their social reasoning in such consultation settings remains challenging since (i) it requires setups where the assistant learns about social situations from subjective user narratives, and (ii) social properties, such as others' intentions, typically lack verifiable ground truth. To address these challenges, we introduce Fuse, a multi-agent simulation framework for studying user-mediated social reasoning. In Fuse, a target agent with a hidden motive interacts with other agents including one representing the user, who then consults the evaluated assistant to infer the target's motive, providing verifiable ground truth by construction. Simulation faithfulness is validated through a human study with 24k annotations. We apply Fuse to 12 LLMs and demonstrate its analytical utility by systematically isolating key factors, showing that (i) user mediation compounds the inherent difficulty of social reasoning; (ii) LLMs exhibit systematic sensitivity to biased user framing; (iii) models can require more details than humans need to reach a correct prediction; and (iv) longer conversations do not always improve performance despite providing opportunities for clarifying questions. We open-source Fuse and a dataset with 21k examples.

articles.titleCn: 可验证的社会推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型助手被广泛用于日常社交咨询，但在咨询场景中评估其社交推理能力仍然具有挑战性，因为（i）这需要助手从主观用户叙述中学习社交情境，以及（ii）社交属性（如他人意图）通常缺乏可验证的真实情况。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了Fuse，一个用于研究用户中介社交推理的多智能体模拟框架。在Fuse中，一个具有隐藏动机的目标智能体与其他智能体（包括代表用户的智能体）互动，用户随后咨询被评估的助手来推断目标的动机，并通过设计提供可验证的真实情况。通过包含24k标注的人类研究验证了模拟的忠实度。我们将Fuse应用于12个大型语言模型，并通过系统地隔离关键因素来展示其分析效用，表明（i）用户中介加剧了社交推理的固有难度；（ii）大型语言模型对有偏见的用户框架表现出系统性敏感性；（iii）模型达到正确预测所需的细节可能比人类更多；（iv）尽管提供了澄清问题的机会，但更长的对话并不总能提升性能。我们开源了Fuse和一个包含21k个示例的数据集。

articles.title: Right Tool, Right Job: Native-Language Evaluation, Tokenizer Sensitivity, and Methodological Findings from a French-Only BabyLM
articles.abstract: We submit MéTRON-FR, a 125M GPT-2 pretrained on 92.47M words of French, to the BabyLM 2026 Strict track. It scores 85.97 +/- 0.17% on QFrBLiMP (a native Quebec-French benchmark of grammatical minimal pairs) and 62.80% on the BabyLM-weighted leaderboard. A cross-lingual GLUE (General Language Understanding Evaluation) protocol that combines French task-data translation with rank-16 LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) produces a sharp task-type gradient: relational tasks gain measurably, while world-knowledge tasks regress. Bilingual Lexicon Induction aligns the French embeddings to GPT-2 at p@1 = 68.84 +/- 8.61%, 18X above chance, suggesting cross-lingual alignment tracks acquired grammatical competence rather than training duration. An ablation study shows that single-token zero-shot scoring is dominated by tokenizer and template artifacts at the child scale, motivating tokenizer-swap sensitivity, placebo-controlled prompting, and native-language minimal-pair benchmarks as standard diagnostics.
articles.comment: Accepted at BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 精准工具，精准任务：源自纯法语BabyLM的母语评价、分词器敏感度及方法论发现
articles.abstractCn: 我们提交了MéTRON-FR，一个基于92.47M法语词的125M GPT-2预训练模型，参加了BabyLM 2026严格赛道。它在QFrBLiMP（一个魁北克法语语法最小对基准）上得分85.97 +/- 0.17%，在BabyLM加权排行榜上得分62.80%。一个结合法语任务数据翻译和秩16LoRA（低秩适配）的跨语言GLUE（通用语言理解评估）协议产生了明显的任务类型梯度：关系型任务显著提升，而世界知识型任务则有所下降。双语词汇归纳将法语嵌入与GPT-2对齐，p@1 = 68.84 +/- 8.61%，比随机猜测高出18倍，表明跨语言对齐追踪的是获得的语法能力而非训练时长。一项消融研究表明，单词零样本评分主要受限于子词分词器和模板的伪影，这促使我们采用子词分词器替换敏感性、安慰剂控制提示和母语最小对基准作为标准诊断方法。

articles.title: CareMirror: Bringing Caregiver Wellbeing into the Dementia Care Ecosystem
articles.abstract: Family caregivers of people living with dementia shoulder emotional and practical responsibilities, yet their own wellbeing often remains peripheral to dementia care. We built CareMirror, an envisioned caregiver wellbeing ecosystem with interconnected caregiver- and clinician-facing interfaces for longitudinal reflection, personalized support, and caregiver-controlled sharing with clinical care. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 14 caregivers, using CareMirror as a design probe to examine how they perceived this ecosystem and what expectations, concerns, and boundaries emerged around clinical connection. Caregivers valued attention to their wellbeing, longitudinal awareness, context-sensitive support, and clinical visibility when it could lead to meaningful follow-up. However, repeated reflection could become burdensome or emotionally difficult, automatic clinical sharing could inhibit candid disclosure, and participants wanted control over what information entered clinical care. They also expected AI to support reflection and communication without replacing caregiver voice or clinician judgment. We contribute design considerations for proactive, clinically connected caregiver wellbeing support.
articles.titleCn: CareMirror：将照护者身心健康融入痴呆照护生态系统
articles.abstractCn: 痴呆症患者家属作为照护者，承担着情感和实际的责任，但他们的自身福祉往往在痴呆症照护中被边缘化。我们构建了CareMirror，这是一个设想中的照护者福祉生态系统，包含相互连接的面向照护者和临床医生界面，用于长期反思、个性化支持和照护者控制的临床信息共享。我们通过半结构化访谈与14位照护者进行交流，将CareMirror作为设计探针，考察他们如何感知这个生态系统，以及围绕临床连接产生的期望、担忧和界限。照护者重视关注自身福祉、长期意识、情境敏感支持和临床可见性，前提是这些信息能促成有意义的后续跟进。然而，反复反思可能变得负担沉重或情感上困难，自动临床信息共享可能抑制坦诚披露，参与者希望控制哪些信息进入临床照护。他们还期望人工智能支持反思和沟通，但不能取代照护者的声音或临床医生的判断。我们为主动、与临床连接的照护者福祉支持提供了设计考量。

articles.title: Enhancing Accessibility of Medical Texts through Large Language Model-Driven Plain Language Adaptation
articles.abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of making complex healthcare information more accessible through automated Plain Language Adaptation (PLA). PLA aims to simplify technical medical language, bridging a critical gap between the complexity of healthcare texts and patients' reading comprehension. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), such as GPT and BART, have opened new possibilities for PLA, especially in zero-shot and few-shot learning contexts where task-specific data is limited. In this work, we leverage the capabilities of LLMs such as GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-pro, and LLaMA for text simplification. Additionally, we incorporate Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) techniques to enhance adaptability and robustness in PLA tasks. Key contributions include a comparative analysis of prompting strategies, finetuning with QLoRA on different LLMs, and the integration of MoA technique. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM-driven PLA, showcasing its potential in making healthcare information more comprehensible while preserving essential content.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Published in the Proceedings of the Thirty-Third Text REtrieval Conference (TREC 2024), Plain Language Adaptation of Biomedical Abstracts (PLABA) track
articles.titleCn: 通过大型语言模型驱动的平实语言改编提升医学文本的可访问性
articles.abstractCn: 本文探讨了通过自动化简明语言改编（PLA）使复杂医疗信息更易获取的挑战。PLA旨在简化专业医疗术语，弥合医疗文本复杂性与患者阅读理解能力之间的关键差距。大型语言模型（LLM）如GPT和BART的最新进展为PLA开辟了新可能，特别是在任务特定数据有限的情况下，如零样本和少样本学习场景。在本工作中，我们利用GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-1.5-pro和LLaMA等LLM的能力进行文本简化。此外，我们结合了混合智能体（MoA）技术以增强PLA任务的适应性和鲁棒性。主要贡献包括提示策略的比较分析、在不同LLM上使用QLoRA进行微调，以及MoA技术的集成。我们的研究结果表明LLM驱动的PLA的有效性，展示了其在保持核心内容的同时使医疗信息更易理解方面的潜力。

articles.title: Large Language Models Develop Belief State Geometry In-Context
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) trained on next-token prediction exhibit remarkable in-context learning (ICL) abilities, yet the representations that support ICL remain poorly understood. We consider such representations in a controlled setting: prompting LLMs with data emitted from hidden Markov models (HMMs) and probing for the corresponding belief state -- the posterior distribution over the HMM's hidden states given the observed token history. Across six open-source LLMs prompted with data from 40 HMMs selected for non-trivial belief structure, we find that belief states are linearly decodable from residual stream activations, with peak probe $R^2$-values from 0.83-0.99 across HMM and LLM combinations, ranging from early to late layers. To establish functional relevance, we intervene directly on the probe-identified subspace via patching and steering, resulting in downstream prediction quality on the order of the untampered model, while controls degrade performance substantially. Together, these results provide representation-level evidence that ICL in open-source LLMs approximates optimal Bayesian prediction over a context-inferred generative model. More broadly, our findings extend prior results linking input-distribution structure to activation geometry: from toy networks trained explicitly on HMM data to production-scale LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型在情境中发展信念状态几何
articles.abstractCn: 在基于下一词预测训练的大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出卓越的上下文学习（ICL）能力，然而支持ICL的表征机制仍缺乏深入理解。我们在一个受控环境中研究此类表征：通过隐马尔可夫模型（HMMs）生成的数据提示LLMs，并探测相应的信念状态——即在观察到词序列历史后，HMM隐藏状态的后验分布。在六个开源LLMs上，我们使用40个被选为具有非平凡信念结构的HMM数据进行了提示，发现信念状态可以从残差流激活中线性解码，不同HMM和LLM组合的峰值探测$R^2$值在0.83至0.99之间，覆盖了从早期到晚期的各层。为验证功能相关性，我们通过打补丁和引导直接干预探测识别的子空间，结果下游预测质量与未受干扰模型相当，而对照实验则显著降低了性能。综合这些结果，为表征层面提供了证据，表明开源LLMs中的ICL近似于在推断的上下文生成模型上进行的贝叶斯最优预测。更广泛而言，我们的发现扩展了先前将输入分布结构与激活几何关联的研究成果：从专门在HMM数据上训练的玩具网络到生产规模LLMs。

articles.title: ECHO: A Matched-Contrast Benchmark for Context-Sensitive Turn-Taking in Full-Duplex Dialogue
articles.abstract: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems must distinguish interruptions that require yielding the floor from backchannels that permit continued speaking. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate events independently and may therefore reward fixed action preferences rather than context-sensitive decisions. We introduce ECHO, a paired diagnostic benchmark for Chinese full-duplex turn-taking. ECHO pairs examples with the same overlap transcript but contrasting preceding multi-turn dialogue contexts, with one requiring Yield and the other Keep. It additionally includes off-talk examples for diagnosing unnecessary yielding. We introduce pair accuracy, which requires correct decisions on both members of a pair and assigns no credit to constant-action policies. Experiments on multiple full-duplex systems show that most exhibit a pronounced bias toward \textsc{Yield}, performing substantially better on interruptions than on backchannels, while another system remains comparatively balanced. These findings demonstrate that interruption-only evaluation can overestimate practical turn-taking reliability. ECHO and its metadata will be publicly released.
articles.titleCn: ECHO：用于全双工对话中上下文敏感轮流发言的匹配对比基准
articles.abstractCn: 全双工语音对话系统必须区分需要让出话语权的中断与允许继续说话的反馈信号。现有基准通常独立评估事件，因此可能奖励固定的动作偏好而非上下文敏感的决策。我们引入ECHO，一个用于中文全双工轮流对话的配对诊断基准。ECHO将具有相同重叠文本但具有对比先前多轮对话上下文的示例配对，其中一个需要执行“让出”，另一个需要执行“保持”。它还包括非说话示例，用于诊断不必要的让出。我们引入了配对准确率，要求对配对中的两个成员做出正确决策，并且不对恒定动作策略给予任何信用。在多个全双工系统上的实验表明，大多数系统表现出明显的“让出”偏好，在处理中断时表现远好于处理反馈信号，而另一个系统则保持相对平衡。这些发现表明，仅评估中断可能会高估实际轮流对话的可靠性。ECHO及其元数据将公开发布。

articles.title: Where Should a Document Live: Context, Representations, or Parameters?
articles.abstract: To answer questions outside of their pre-training data, large language models (LLMs) need access to new information, which can be presented in the context window as documents, encoded into the model's parameters, or injected as latent representations. However, each of these methods comes with different efficiency, cost, and performance trade-offs, with no single winner. We present a controlled comparison of representation-based (KV-cache based) and parametric (fine-tuning-based) adaptation methods on five knowledge-intensive benchmarks. We show that in the oracle setting, Cartridges (KV) are the most accurate injection method at nearly every storage budget, outperforming parametric methods by 10 points. Compaction (KV) matches Cartridges only at low compression rates, lagging behind the parametric methods by 10 points at rates higher than $50\times$. In the more realistic multi-document retrieval scenario, Cartridges are the only method that matches in-context learning (ICL), leading the parametric methods by 29 points and Compaction by 15 points. Nonetheless, Cartridges are also the only method, besides full fine-tuning and large MLP adapters, that suffers from catastrophic forgetting, i.e., a 6% performance degradation on control benchmarks, with 13% in coding.
articles.titleCn: 一份文档应该存放在哪里：背景、表示形式还是参数？
articles.abstractCn: 为了回答超出其预训练数据范围的问题，大型语言模型（LLM）需要获取新信息，这些信息可以通过文档形式呈现于上下文窗口中，编码到模型的参数中，或注入为潜在表示。然而，这些方法各有不同的效率、成本和性能权衡，没有哪种方法能独占鳌头。我们通过在五个知识密集型基准测试上对基于表示（基于KV缓存）和参数化（基于微调）的适应方法进行受控比较，展示了这一结果。我们发现，在神谕设置下，Cartridges（KV）在几乎所有存储预算下都是最准确的注入方法，比参数化方法高出10个百分点。Compaction（KV）仅在低压缩率下与Cartridges持平，在高于50倍的压缩率下，其性能落后于参数化方法10个百分点。在更现实的多文档检索场景中，Cartridges是唯一能与情境学习（ICL）匹敌的方法，比参数化方法领先29个百分点，比Compaction领先15个百分点。尽管如此，Cartridges也是除了全微调和大型MLP适配器之外唯一会遭受灾难性遗忘的方法，即在控制基准测试上性能下降6%，在编码任务中下降13%。

articles.title: Vroom-Vroom at SHROOM-Visions: A Multi-Judge Committee for Detecting Hallucinated Spans in Vision-Language Outputs
articles.abstract: This paper describes our submission to the SHROOM-Visions shared task on detecting and classifying hallucinated character spans in vision-language model outputs across four languages. We employ several fine-tuned vision-language models as independent annotators and combine their span predictions through character-level majority voting, and additionally explore activation probes. The approach ranks first in three of four languages and places on the podium in every language and metric. Our analysis indicates that disagreement among diverse models tracks disagreement among human annotators.
articles.comment: Accepted to UncertaiNLP 2026 @ EMNLP. SHROOM-Visions 2026 shared task system description
articles.titleCn: SHROOM-Visions中的Vroom-Vroom：用于检测视觉语言输出中幻觉片段的多评委委员会
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了我们在SHROOM-Visions共享任务上的提交，该任务旨在检测和分类视觉语言模型输出中四种语言下的幻觉字符片段。我们采用多个经过微调的视觉语言模型作为独立的标注者，并通过字符级多数投票结合它们的片段预测，此外还探索了激活探针。该方法在四种语言的其中三种中排名第一，并在所有语言和指标中都位列前三。我们的分析表明，不同模型之间的分歧与人类标注者之间的分歧相一致。

articles.title: Towards Detecting AI-Assisted Responses in Online Surveys
articles.abstract: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains underexplored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired with genuine human responses. Our evaluation of existing machine-generated text (MGT) detectors shows that naive AI usage is readily detectable, whereas persona-grounded agents that mimic entire respondents push detector performance toward chance. We further show that agentic completion cannot fully replicate respondent-level behaviour and leaves distinctive behavioural traces. While individual cues can be circumvented by targeted prompting, a simple few-shot, training-free aggregator over these cues improves mean AUROC by +0.14 over the best existing detector across agentic settings. Our project is available at https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURRE.
articles.titleCn: 面向在线调查中AI辅助回复的检测
articles.abstractCn: 利用大型语言模型（LLM）完成在线调查会影响基于调查的研究有效性，但检测此类使用情况仍处于探索阶段。我们引入了一个名为ASURRE的初始基准数据集，用于AI辅助的问卷调查参与，以捕捉从完全生成和修订到基于角色代理完成的使用策略。在这些策略的控制下，我们使用多个LLM在三个不同学科的三个真实世界调查中生成LLM辅助的问卷回答，并与真实人类回答进行配对。我们对现有的机器生成文本（MGT）检测器的评估表明，简单的AI使用情况很容易被检测到，而模仿整个受访者的基于角色的代理则将检测器性能推向随机水平。我们进一步表明，代理完成不能完全复制受访者层面的行为，并留下独特的行为痕迹。虽然单个线索可能被针对性的提示规避，但一个简单的、无需训练的、基于这些线索的聚合器在代理设置中比现有最佳检测器平均AUROC提高了+0.14。我们的项目可在https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURRE获取。

articles.title: Zero-shot narrative detection in social messaging
articles.abstract: This study investigates the zero-shot ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify and classify hidden narratives in social messages. Our research hypothesis is that LLMs' extensive contextual knowledge allows them to interpret messages on a deeper, pragmatic level, going beyond basic sentiment or topic analysis. Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of training examples. In contrast, automatically generated descriptions or the use of few examples (few-shot) often degrade accuracy due to subtle shifts in framing. The study also finds that ensemble methods, particularly majority voting, enhance robustness and that larger models perform best while also being less sensitive to prompt variations. The findings validate that LLMs can effectively detect strategic narratives in a zero-shot setting, and when combined with simple ensembling and human-written descriptions, they can rival supervised systems, offering a scalable solution for narrative detection, specially when there is no training data for the vast majority of domains.
articles.titleCn: 社交消息中的零样本叙事检测
articles.abstractCn: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在识别和分类社交信息中隐藏叙事的零样本能力。我们的研究假设是，LLMs广泛的环境知识使其能够以更深入、更具实践性的层次解读信息，超越基本情感或主题分析。在Dipromats和SemEval数据集上的实验表明，向模型提供人类编写的叙事描述能显著提升性能，而无需训练样本。相比之下，自动生成的描述或使用少量示例（少样本）往往会因框架的微妙变化而降低准确率。研究还发现，集成方法，特别是多数投票，增强了鲁棒性，而较大的模型表现最佳且对提示变化不敏感。这些发现证实了LLMs能够在零样本环境下有效检测策略性叙事，当结合简单的集成和人类编写的描述时，它们可以媲美监督系统，为叙事检测提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，尤其是在大多数领域缺乏训练数据的情况下。

articles.title: Towards Illusions Awareness in Cyber-Physical System's Design
articles.abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) operate through a continuous sense-compute-act loop within an open context environment, making it impossible to anticipate all the situations the system will face. To cope with this openness, stakeholders rely on assumptions, formalized into design models. However, these assumptions may no longer hold once the system is confronted with runtime reality, resulting in a discrepancy between expected and observed behaviour known in literature as the reality gap. Existing approaches mainly focus on reducing or overcoming it by making simulations more faithful to reality, with no unified methodology to structure and exploit invalidated assumptions that give rise to this gap as reusable design knowledge. We refer to the persistent reliance on invalidated assumptions -and the resulting false confidence in the design model's operational validity -as design illusions, and argue that they need to be made explicit, structured, and exploited as knowledge to support better design decisions. We propose a conceptual pipeline for illusions-awareness that identifies, classifies, characterizes, and leverages illusions to transform them into actionable design knowledge.
articles.titleCn: 面向物理信息系统设计中的错觉意识
articles.abstractCn: 物理信息系统（CPS）在开放的环境下通过持续的感受-计算-执行循环运行，这使得系统无法预见到所有可能面临的情况。为了应对这种开放性，利益相关者依赖于假设，并将这些假设形式化为设计模型。然而，一旦系统面对运行时现实，这些假设可能就不再成立，从而导致预期行为与观察行为之间的差异，这在文献中被称为现实差距。现有方法主要集中于通过使模拟更贴近现实来减少或克服这种差距，但没有统一的方怯来构建和利用导致这种差距的失效假设，将其转化为可重用的设计知识。我们将对失效假设的持续依赖——以及由此产生的对设计模型运行有效性的错误信心——称为设计幻觉，并主张它们需要被明确化、结构化并作为知识加以利用，以支持更好的设计决策。我们提出了一种具有幻觉感知概念管道，用于识别、分类、表征和利用幻觉，将其转化为可执行的设计知识。

articles.title: Persistent Recurrent Memory Between Transformer Layers - Improves Language Model Generalization
articles.abstract: We introduce a simple architectural modification to decoder-only transformers: a persistent recurrent state that observes hidden representations via cross-attention, updates itself through a GRU, and modulates subsequent processing via gated addition. Inserted between the lower and upper halves of a 6-layer transformer, this module adds only 3.7\% additional parameters while reducing evaluation loss from $2.438 \pm 0.004$ to $1.743 \pm 0.018$, corresponding to a 28.5\% reduction on held-out language modeling data. The improvement is statistically significant across 5 random seeds ($p < 0.01$) and corresponds to reduced overfitting (generalization gap 0.12 vs 0.26). Through controlled ablations, we demonstrate that the improvement stems entirely from the persistent memory topology, not from auxiliary self-prediction objectives. A model with identical topology but no auxiliary loss performs equivalently, while a random auxiliary loss provides no benefit. Representation probing reveals that the persistent state encodes narrative position (52\% vs 33\% chance level)---information that standard attention maintains less efficiently. Our results suggest that bridging transformer layers with a lightweight recurrent memory is a simple, effective approach to improving generalization in small-scale language models.
articles.titleCn: Transformer层之间的持久性循环记忆——提升语言模型泛化能力
articles.abstractCn: 我们为仅解码器结构的Transformer引入了一种简单的架构修改：一种持久循环状态，该状态通过交叉注意力观察隐藏表示，通过GRU进行自我更新，并通过门控加法调节后续处理。该模块插入在6层Transformer的上下两部分之间，仅增加了3.7%的额外参数，同时将评估损失从$2.438 \pm 0.004$降低到$1.743 \pm 0.018$，在保留的语言建模数据上减少了28.5%。这种改进在5个随机种子下具有统计学意义（$p < 0.01$），并且对应于过拟合的减少（泛化差距0.12 vs 0.26）。通过受控的消融实验，我们证明这种改进完全源于持久的记忆拓扑结构，而非辅助自预测目标。具有相同拓扑结构但没有辅助损失的模型表现相当，而随机辅助损失则没有带来任何好处。表示探测显示，持久状态编码了叙事位置（52% vs 33%的几率水平）——标准注意力更不有效地维持的信息。我们的结果表明，通过轻量级循环记忆连接Transformer层是提高小规模语言模型泛化能力的一种简单有效的方法。

articles.title: ECHO: Early-layer Collaborative Hierarchical Orchestration with Bonus Logits in Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: While draft-model-free speculative decoding offers a promising path to efficient LLM inference, it is frequently constrained by stale draft candidates and the high computational cost of the verification. To address these challenges, we propose ECHO, a hierarchical dual-loop framework that exploits the functional asymmetry between LLM layers. Leveraging the high discriminative efficiency of early layers and the authoritative distribution of final layers, ECHO bifurcates inference into a high-frequency inner loop and a low-frequency outer loop. Within the inner loop, early-layer bonus logits drive rapid, multi-step draft-tree exploration at a minimal cost. Simultaneously, the outer loop performs authoritative full-model verification through a state-reuse mechanism. Crucially, the outer loop also utilizes final-layer bonus logits to correct existing paths and supplement the tree with high-confidence candidates for subsequent cycles. Experimental results across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that ECHO significantly boosts mean accepted tokens and achieves a 2.4$\times$ to 2.9$\times$ speedup, outperforming existing state-of-the-art baselines with negligible engineering overhead and no extra deployment parameters, albeit with a one-shot fine-tuning dependency for optimal acceleration. The code is available at https://github.com/whucs21Mzy/ECHO.
articles.titleCn: ECHO：早期层协同分层编排，在推测解码中带有奖励逻辑
articles.abstractCn: 虽然基于无模型的推测解码为高效的LLM推理提供了一条有前景的路径，但它经常受到陈旧草稿候选和验证高计算成本的制约。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ECHO，这是一个利用LLM层之间功能不对称性的分层双环框架。利用早期层的高判别效率和最终层的权威分布，ECHO将推理分为高频内环和低频外环。在内环中，早期层奖励逻辑位以极低成本驱动快速、多步的草稿树探索。同时，外环通过状态重用机制执行权威的全模型验证。关键的是，外环还利用最终层奖励逻辑位来修正现有路径，并为后续周期为树补充高置信度的候选。跨多个基准的实验结果表明，ECHO显著提高了平均接受token数，并实现了2.4倍至2.9倍的加速，优于现有的最先进基线，尽管其工程开销微乎其微且无需额外的部署参数，但最佳加速依赖于单次微调依赖。代码可在https://github.com/whucs21Mzy/ECHO获取。

articles.title: AraMIP: Extending MIPVU Towards Metaphor Identification in Arabic
articles.abstract: Metaphor research has gained increasing attention due to its relevance to linguistic creativity, language use, cognitive processes, and related areas. While many efforts have been devoted to metaphor identification and annotation in English and other languages, Arabic remains under-resourced in this area. In this work, we propose the Arabic Metaphor Identification Procedure (AraMIP), a novel guideline for Arabic metaphor annotation. AraMIP builds on the widely used Metaphor Identification Procedure Vrije Universiteit (MIPVU) framework, incorporating adaptations that accounts for the language-specific properties of Arabic. We distinguish three major types of Arabic figurative language: Isti'ara (metaphor), kinaya (metonymy/indirect expression), and tashbih (simile), and annotate a pilot dataset of 300 sentences (5277 words). Our analysis reveals key challenges specific to Arabic, including morphological complexity, inconsistencies in dictionary sense ordering, and the absence of standardized contextual materials for annotators. This work contributes a first step toward standardized Arabic figurative instances and facilitates the development of larger annotated resources, thereby supporting future research on figurative language in Arabic.
articles.comment: Accepted at the Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: AraMIP：将MIPVU扩展至阿拉伯语隐喻识别
articles.abstractCn: 隐喻研究因其与语言创造力、语言使用、认知过程及相关领域的关联性而日益受到关注。尽管许多研究致力于英语及其他语言的隐喻识别和标注，但阿拉伯语在这一领域仍资源匮乏。本研究提出了阿拉伯语隐喻识别程序（AraMIP），这是一种用于阿拉伯语隐喻标注的新颖指南。AraMIP基于广泛使用的代尔夫特大学隐喻识别程序框架（MIPVU），并结合了针对阿拉伯语语言特性的适应性调整。我们区分了三种主要的阿拉伯语修辞语言类型：伊斯蒂'拉（隐喻）、基纳亚（转喻/间接表达）和塔什比（明喻），并对300个句子（5277个单词）的试点数据集进行了标注。我们的分析揭示了阿拉伯语特有的关键挑战，包括形态复杂性、词典释义顺序的不一致性，以及标注者缺乏标准化的语境材料。这项工作为阿拉伯语修辞实例的标准化迈出了第一步，促进了更大规模标注资源的发展，从而支持未来阿拉伯语修辞语言研究。

articles.title: Easy to Catch a Liar, Hard to Clear an Honest One: Language Models Diagnosing a Corrupted Reward Channel from a Verified Record
articles.abstract: An agent that learns from rewards has to trust whatever reports those rewards. When the reports suddenly change, either the world changed or the reporter broke. From the reports alone these are indistinguishable, and reinforcement learning theory shows that no amount of further experience separates them. The prescribed escape is richer data about the reporter itself. We ask whether a frozen language model, handed exactly that data, uses it. We build a two-option game in which a payout swap and a lying reporter produce byte-identical histories. Then we add one verified record: an independent check of one round's real result, printed beside what the reporter said about that round. That single line settles the case. We ask three large models, from two families, to answer one question with one letter. Is the reporter honest or lying? They catch a lying reporter almost perfectly. At the 70B class that holds in every condition we tried; the 32B model slips in one wording. They clear an honest reporter far less often, and how often depends on things that should not matter. Averaged over rounds, letters, and wordings, a 72B model calls an honest reporter a liar 38% of the time when nothing has changed at all, and 58% of the time when the payouts moved. A 70B model from a second family calls an honest reporter a liar 26% and 48% of the time. The failure is not one of reading, because in the situation where nothing changed the same models score 0.96 to 1.00 with the answer printed in the prompt. Which surface feature drives it differs by family. For the Qwen models it is which round the record names, and for Llama it is which letter stands for "honest." Adding the record to a prompt that already states the answer makes Llama less likely to give that answer. We had registered a prediction for that 58% before the run: 35%. The failure is larger than we expected.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 9 tables. Code, prompts, answer keys, and every scored output: https://github.com/IamArmanNikkhah/easy-to-catch-a-liar
articles.titleCn: 轻易识破骗子，却难辨清白者：语言模型从已验证记录中诊断受损的奖励通道
articles.abstractCn: 一个从奖励中学习的智能体必须信任所有报告这些奖励的信息。当报告突然发生变化时，要么是环境发生了变化，要么是报告者出了问题。仅凭报告本身，这两种情况是无法区分的，强化学习理论表明，无论多少进一步的经验都无法将它们区分开来。规定的解决方案是关于报告者本身的更丰富的数据。我们询问一个冻结的语言模型，在收到完全相同的数据时是否会使用它。我们构建了一个两选项游戏，其中支付交换和撒谎的报告者产生了字节完全相同的记录。然后我们添加了一条经过验证的记录：对某一轮真实结果的独立检查，旁边打印了报告者对该轮的说法。这一行记录足以解决争议。我们要求三个大型模型，来自两个系列，用单个字母回答一个问题。报告者诚实还是撒谎？它们几乎完美地抓住了撒谎的报告者。在70B类模型中，无论我们尝试何种条件，32B模型在措辞上出现了一个错误。它们很少清除诚实的报告者，而频率取决于不应影响结果的因素。在轮次、字母和措辞上取平均值，当没有任何变化时，72B模型将诚实报告者称为撒谎者的概率为38%，当支付发生变化时为58%。来自第二个系列的70B模型将诚实报告者称为撒谎者的概率为26%和48%。失败不是因为阅读能力，因为在没有任何变化的情况下，相同的模型在提示中打印答案时得分在0.96到1.00之间。驱动这种行为的表面特征因系列而异。对于Qwen模型，是记录名称的轮次，而对于Llama，是代表“诚实”的字母。将记录添加到已经说明答案的提示中，使Llama不太可能给出那个答案。我们在运行前已经注册了58%的预测：35%。失败比我们预期的要大。

articles.title: Psychological Effects of Cultural Upheavals from Millions of Song Lyrics Over 100 Years
articles.abstract: Cultural upheavals impact many aspects of social life, and many studies have investigated their impact on language patterns. However, few investigations have isolated the impact of upheavals on individuals at scale in popular media. The current work evaluated millions of song lyrics spanning more than a century in search of within-artist and between-artist signals of distress from the Vietnam War, the terrorist attacks of 9/11, and COVID-19. Compared to a five-year baseline, rates of self-references - a marker of psychological distancing - were significantly reduced after the Vietnam War and September 11th. Cognitive processing terms were elevated post-upheaval vs. pre-upheaval, which indicated artists' increased attempts to make meaning from such massive disruptions. Content patterns corroborated these findings as artists wrote more about "life and freedom" (societal conditions) and less about "courtship and nightlife" (interpersonal connection) following the upheavals. Cultural upheavals modify individual and collective verbal behavior, demonstrating their far-reaching impact on society.
articles.titleCn: 百万年歌曲百年文化动荡的心理影响
articles.abstractCn: 文化动荡对社会生活的许多方面产生影响，许多研究探讨了它们对语言模式的影响。然而，很少有研究在流行媒体中大规模地分离出动荡对个人的影响。当前的研究评估了跨越一个多世纪的上千万首歌曲歌词，以寻找越南战争、9/11恐怖袭击和COVID-19带来的艺术家内部和艺术家之间的痛苦信号。与五年基线相比，越南战争和9/11之后，自我指涉率——心理距离的标志——显著降低。认知处理术语在动荡后高于动荡前，这表明艺术家们试图从这种大规模的动荡中寻找意义。内容模式证实了这些发现，因为动荡后，艺术家们更多地谈论“生活与自由”（社会状况），而较少谈论“求爱与夜生活”（人际联系）。文化动荡改变了个人和集体的语言行为，展示了它们对社会产生的深远影响。

articles.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
articles.abstract: Looped Transformers achieve strong performance with compact parameter sizes by repeatedly applying a shared stack of Transformer blocks across recurrent depths. However, they incur higher decoding latency than standard Transformer models of comparable parameter size because shared weights are accessed at every recurrent depth. To improve decoding efficiency, self-speculative decoding is particularly well suited to Looped Transformers, as their intermediate recurrent states can directly provide draft predictions without an auxiliary draft model. We therefore propose LoopSpec, a training-free self-speculative decoding framework tailored for Looped Transformers. LoopSpec extracts draft tokens from early recurrent states and operates in a pipelined manner, overlapping draft generation of future tokens with target verification of the current token. To improve draft accuracy without excessive compute overhead, we introduce a selective second proposal from deeper recurrent depth while ensuring lossless decoding under both greedy and sampling regimes. Furthermore, we derive the optimal proposal depths in closed form and show the prediction matches measurement. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, LoopSpec achieves up to 6.83$\times$ inference speedup across diverse Looped Transformers.
articles.titleCn: 循环规范：循环Transformer的流水线自推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 循环Transformer通过在循环深度上重复应用一个共享的Transformer块堆栈，以紧凑的参数尺寸实现了优异的性能。然而，由于在每一层循环深度上都会访问共享权重，它们比同等参数规模的标凈Transformer模型具有更高的解码延迟。为了提高解码效率，自我推测解码特别适用于循环Transformer，因为它们的中间循环状态可以直接提供草稿预测，无需辅助的草稿模型。因此，我们提出了LoopSpec，这是一个为循环Transformer量身定制的、无需训练的自我推测解码框架。LoopSpec从早期的循环状态中提取草稿标记，并以流水线方式运行，将未来标记的草稿生成与当前标记的目标验证重叠。为了在不增加过多的计算开销的情况下提高草稿的准确性，我们在保证在贪婪和采样模式下解码无损的前提下，引入了从更深循环深度进行选择性第二次提议的方法。此外，我们以封闭形式推导出最优提议深度，并证明了预测与测量结果一致。在推理和编码基准测试中，LoopSpec在多种循环Transformer上实现了高达6.83倍的推理速度提升。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Counterfactual Self-Explanations in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models can easily generate explanations for their own outputs, but such self-explanations are not necessarily faithful to the model's behavior. We study this issue through counterfactual self-explanations, where a model minimally edits an input so that its own prediction changes. Across sentiment analysis and natural language inference, we evaluate ten instruction-tuned models from the LLaMA-3 and Qwen-2.5 families, measuring faithfulness, minimality, and alignment with human-annotated rationales. Our results show that model scale is the strongest determinant of explanation quality: larger models are substantially more likely to generate counterfactuals that flip their own predictions and target decision-relevant evidence. In contrast, the rationale-guided condition produces edit-minimal counterfactuals that are also more human-aligned. However, it does not consistently improve faithfulness. Overall, counterfactual self-explanations can provide useful behavioral evidence about model decisions, but their reliability depends strongly on model capacity and should be empirically validated rather than assumed.
articles.titleCn: 对大型语言模型中反事实自我解释的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够轻易地为其输出生成解释，但这些自我解释未必忠实于模型的行为。我们通过反事实自我解释来研究这一问题，即模型对输入进行最小化修改，从而改变其自身预测。在情感分析和自然语言推理任务中，我们评估了LLaMA-3和Qwen-2.5系列中的十种指令微调模型，测量了其解释的忠实度、最小化程度以及与人类标注理由的一致性。我们的结果表明，模型规模是解释质量的最强决定因素：较大的模型更有可能生成反事实解释，从而翻转自身预测并针对决策相关的证据。相比之下，在理由引导条件下，生成的编辑最小化反事实解释与人类标注理由的一致性更高。然而，它并不始终能提高忠实度。总体而言，反事实自我解释可以为模型决策提供有用的行为证据，但其可靠性高度依赖于模型能力，应通过实证验证而非假设来确认。

articles.title: Shared-Prefix KV Reuse Across Standard LoRA Adapters: Quality and Serving Tradeoffs
articles.abstract: A common small-model deployment runs one shared backbone with several LoRA specialists that answer over the same context. Serving them naively re-prefills that shared context once per specialist. We study a narrow, practical question: for already-trained standard LoRA adapters -- not adapters retrained for cache compatibility -- how much task quality is preserved if the backbone's prefill KV cache is computed once and reused across specialists, and what does that buy in serving cost? On a Qwen3-1.7B backbone with two adapters (extractive QA on HotpotQA, arithmetic reasoning on GSM8K), we sweep the boundary at which the specialist takes over from the reused base cache and measure paired quality differences and serving cost. Full-prefix reuse had the lowest prefill cost and a small quality difference on held-out GSM8K (Delta = -4.6 EM at a 160-token budget; -3.0 at 320 tokens; -0.8 under a second training seed -- all favoring native, only the first excluding zero, and the magnitude not consistent). Partial recomputation provided no demonstrated advantage. Neither quality equivalence nor a general boundary-selection rule is established. We also report a closed-form ridge KV translator that did not beat direct reuse, and specialist-dependence contrasts whose intervals all include zero. The measured serving benefit is warm-cache time-to-first-token, which grows with context (~16x at 8K); two-branch peak memory was only 12% lower and, on inspection, the prefix was never physically shared across branches -- this implementation reuses KV values but copies their storage, so shared-cache memory savings are not achieved.
articles.titleCn: 标准LoRA适配器中的共享前缀KV重用：质量与服务权衡
articles.abstractCn: 一种常见的微型模型部署运行一个共享骨干网络，并配备多个LoRA专家，这些专家在同一上下文中进行响应。在服务它们时，通常会为每个专家重新填充共享上下文。我们研究了一个狭窄且实际的问题：对于已经训练好的标准LoRA适配器——而不是为了缓存兼容性而重新训练的适配器——如果骨干网络的预填充KV缓存一次性计算并跨专家复用，能保留多少任务质量，以及这对服务成本有何影响？在一个包含两个适配器的Qwen3-1.7B骨干网络上（一个用于HotpotQA的抽取式问答，另一个用于GSM8K的算术推理），我们扫描了专家从复用基础缓存接管任务的边界，并测量了配对质量差异和服务成本。全前缀复用具有最低的预填充成本，并在保留的GSM8K上存在较小的质量差异（在160个token预算下Delta为-4.6 EM；在320个token下Delta为-3.0；在第二个训练种子下Delta为-0.8——所有结果都倾向于原生方法，只有第一个排除零，且幅度不一致）。部分重新计算并未显示出优势。既没有建立质量等效性，也没有确立通用的边界选择规则。我们还报告了一种闭式岭KV转换器，它并未超越直接复用，以及专家依赖性对比，其区间均包含零。测量的服务收益是热缓存时间到第一个token的时间，该时间随上下文增长（在8K时增长了约16倍）；双分支峰值内存仅降低了12%，经检查，前缀从未在分支间物理共享——这种实现复用KV值但复制其存储，因此并未实现共享缓存内存的节省。

articles.title: Interactive Memory Learning for Long-Term Conversations
articles.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models have significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents in modeling long-term conversations. Despite these successes, existing approaches typically adopt a static heuristic paradigm, where information is passively archived without adaptive memory valuation. Consequently, these methods fail to self-evolve or align their memory management with evolving user needs. To address this, we propose ICML (InteraCtive Memory Learning), a multi-agent framework that transforms the memory mechanism from a passive archive into a learnable, interactive memory policy. Specifically, we first employ a session synthesis pipeline to generate expert data, facilitating rapid test-time adaptation in unseen scenarios. Building on this, ICML utilizes an online reinforcement learning mechanism where a Planner agent selectively encodes high-value information and a Trigger agent dynamically retrieves it to optimize response quality, whereby the two agents co-evolve through continuous interaction feedback. Crucially, both agents are synchronized through a delayed reward mechanism that propagates future feedback back to earlier storage decisions, ensuring memory policies are precisely aligned with user expectations. Experimental results demonstrate that ICML significantly outperforms strong baselines, exhibiting the unique capability to continuously improve response quality as interactions accumulate.
articles.titleCn: 交互式记忆学习用于长期对话
articles.abstractCn: 近期大型语言模型的发展显著提升了智能体在模拟长期对话方面的能力。尽管取得了这些成功，现有方法通常采用静态启发式范式，其中信息被动存储而缺乏自适应记忆评估。因此，这些方法无法自我进化或使其记忆管理适应不断变化用户需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ICML（交互式记忆学习），这是一个多智能体框架，将记忆机制从被动存储转变为可学习、交互式记忆策略。具体而言，我们首先采用会话合成管道生成专家数据，以促进在未知场景中的快速测试时适应。在此基础上，ICML利用在线强化学习机制，其中规划智能体选择性地编码高价值信息，触发智能体动态检索信息以优化响应质量，两个智能体通过持续交互反馈共同进化。关键在于，两个智能体通过延迟奖励机制同步，将未来反馈传递回早期存储决策，确保记忆策略精确匹配用户期望。实验结果表明，ICML显著优于强基线，展现出随着交互累积持续提升响应质量的独特能力。

articles.title: EviScope: Paired Counterfactual Evidence Diagnostics for Faithful and Efficient Grounded Language Models
articles.abstract: Grounded language-model systems are often evaluated by final answer accuracy, yet a correct answer can be unsupported, drawn from the wrong source, or produced when evidence is insufficient or contradictory. We introduce EviScope, a paired counterfactual benchmark that holds the question fixed while adding, removing, distracting, or contradicting its evidence. EviScope-v1.1 contains 40 four-condition quartets with repaired counterfactual claims and span-level support labels for automatic evaluation. Across 960 gold-blind generations from Qwen2.5-7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, paired metrics expose model-dependent grounding behavior that answer accuracy hides. On two local open models, an explicit evidence-action gate underperforms vanilla RAG on QCS: 0.15 vs. 0.50 for Qwen and 0.10 vs. 0.375 for Llama. Gemini reaches 0.944 joint success under both prompts, yet still answers 5% of conflict cases after contradiction insertion. EviScope therefore distinguishes unsupported answering, conflict blindness, and wrong non-answer actions rather than scoring answers alone.
articles.comment: Accepted as an archival short paper in GroundLM Findings at EMNLP 2026; to appear in the GroundLM 2026 workshop proceedings in the ACL Anthology
articles.titleCn: EviScope：用于可信且高效的有根语言模型的成对反事实证据诊断
articles.abstractCn: 基于语言模型的系统通常通过最终答案的准确性进行评估，然而，一个正确的答案可能缺乏支持、来自错误来源，或者在证据不足或矛盾时产生。我们介绍了EviScope，一个成对反事实基准，它保持问题固定，同时添加、移除、干扰或矛盾其证据。EviScope-v1.1包含40个四条件四元组，具有修复的反事实声明和跨度级别的支持标签，用于自动评估。在Qwen2.5-7B、Llama 3.1 8B和Gemini 3.5 Flash生成的960个金盲样本中，成对指标揭示了模型依赖的接地行为，而答案准确性则隐藏了这些行为。在两个本地开源模型上，显式证据-动作门在QCS上的表现不如普通RAG：对于Qwen为0.15 vs 0.50，对于Llama为0.10 vs 0.375。Gemini在两种提示下联合成功率达到了0.944，但在插入矛盾后仍然回答了5%的冲突案例。因此，EviScope区分了不受支持的回答、冲突盲点和错误的非回答行为，而不仅仅是评分答案。

articles.title: Audio-Visual Turn-taking Prediction in Cocktail Party Scenarios
articles.abstract: Current predictive turn-taking models (PTTMs) achieve strong performance on benchmarks with controlled acoustic conditions and clean audio signals. Their generalisation to conversations with overlapping speech and background interference remains underexplored. In this research, we evaluate audio-visual PTTMs trained with clean data on a challenging cocktail-party testbed derived from the AVCocktail dataset, and analyse their adaptation behaviour to this new domain. Experimental results show consistent performance degradation across audio and visual modalities under noisy conditions, with up to 38% relative drop in weighted F1. Fine-tuning on the new domain improves robustness, but gains vary across modalities and depend on the size of the available pre-training data. These findings provide insights into the different generalisation and adaptation capabilities of the audio and visual modalities, and indicate the need for robust modelling strategies to adapt to the complexities of human interactions in noise. All code and turn labels are made publicly available to facilitate further research.
articles.comment: Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026. This version includes an appendix about manual verified labels for AVCocktail
articles.titleCn: 鸡尾酒会场景下的音视频轮流预测
articles.abstractCn: 当前预测轮流发言模型（PTTMs）在具有受控声学条件和清晰音频信号的标准测试集上表现出色。然而，它们在处理重叠语音和背景干扰的对话场景中的泛化能力仍需深入探索。本研究评估了在清晰数据上训练的视听PTTMs在AVCocktail数据集衍生的鸡尾酒会测试平台上的表现，并分析了它们对新领域的适应行为。实验结果表明，在噪声条件下，音频和视觉模态的性能均出现持续下降，加权F1值相对下降高达38%。在新领域上进行微调可以提高鲁棒性，但增益因模态而异，且取决于可用的预训练数据规模。这些发现揭示了音频和视觉模态在泛化和适应能力上的差异，并表明需要鲁棒的建模策略来适应噪声中人类互动的复杂性。所有代码和发言标签均已公开，以促进进一步研究。

articles.title: Diagnosing the Fact-Grounding Gap in Multi-Hop Question Answering
articles.abstract: Multi-hop question answering requires combining information from multiple documents to answer complex questions. These systems have grown increasingly capable, yet when they fail, the error is typically attributed to not finding the right documents. Whether this holds at the level of individual reasoning steps remains largely unexamined. We investigate this across three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks and find that failures decompose into two distinct modes: retrieval failures, where the needed passage was not retrieved, and extraction failures, where the passage was retrieved but the needed fact could not be extracted - a phenomenon we term the fact-grounding gap. Extraction failures account for nearly half of all per-hop deficiencies and are invisible to standard retrieval metrics. They remain unresolved by every retrieval intervention we test, establishing a ceiling for retrieval-only improvements. The gap's severity varies across benchmarks and question types, but extraction failures appear on every dataset we measure. Our findings reveal that retrieval failures and extraction failures are fundamentally different bottlenecks requiring different solutions - a distinction absent from current evaluation practice.
articles.titleCn: 诊断多跳问答中的事实-背景差距
articles.abstractCn: 多跳问答需要结合多个文档的信息来回答复杂问题。这些系统已经变得越来越强大，但当它们出错时，错误通常被归因于未能找到正确的文档。这一点在单个推理步骤层面是否成立，仍然很大程度上未经检验。我们通过三个标准的多跳问答基准测试进行了研究，发现失败可以分解为两种不同的模式：检索失败，即所需段落未被检索到；以及提取失败，即段落被检索到但所需事实无法提取——我们将这种现象称为事实基础差距。提取失败占所有每跳缺陷的近一半，且对标准的检索指标不可见。它们无法通过我们测试的任何检索干预措施解决，为纯检索改进设定了上限。差距的严重程度在不同基准测试和问题类型中有所不同，但提取失败出现在我们测量的每个数据集上。我们的研究结果表明，检索失败和提取失败是根本不同的瓶颈，需要不同的解决方案——而当前评估实践中缺乏这种区分。

articles.title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents
articles.abstract: Lifelong conversational agents rely on memory systems to maintain deep, context-aware interactions with users. However, existing explicit textual memory pipelines suffer from a severe information bottleneck, often losing subtle behavioral patterns and emotional shifts. Furthermore, being typically static post-deployment, they cannot autonomously adapt to personal habits and preferences without manual feedback. Cognitive science, however, suggests that humans maintain mental models purely in a latent space and continuously refine them through predictive coding. Inspired by this, we propose \textbf{ThinkFlow}, a novel end-to-end latent memory framework for lifelong conversational agents. ThinkFlow bypasses the text bottleneck by dynamically compressing conversational flows into probabilistic latent memory skills, autonomously consolidating complex user states into disentangled, continuous vectors without semantic interference. To break this barrier, we introduce a test-time evolution paradigm. By coupling teacher-guided latent alignment to bootstrap the initial state with a self-supervised next-user-utterance prediction task for continuous refinement, the framework successfully overcomes cold-start challenges and achieves label-free lifelong personalization. Extensive experiments on long-term conversation benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkFlow significantly outperforms prevailing memory systems, providing highly personalized and contextually accurate responses over extended multi-session interactions.
articles.titleCn: ThinkFlow：适用于终身对话代理的自进化概率潜在记忆
articles.abstractCn: 终身对话代理依赖于记忆系统来维持与用户的深度、上下文感知交互。然而，现有的显式文本记忆管道存在严重的信息瓶颈，常常丢失微妙的行为模式和情绪变化。此外，它们在部署后通常是静态的，无法在没有人工反馈的情况下自主适应用户的习性和偏好。认知科学表明，人类纯粹在潜在空间中维持心智模型，并通过预测编码不断对其进行完善。受此启发，我们提出了\textbf{ThinkFlow}，这是一种用于终身对话代理的新型端到端潜在记忆框架。ThinkFlow通过动态压缩对话流为概率性潜在记忆技能，绕过文本瓶颈，自主地将复杂用户状态整合为解耦的连续向量，而不会产生语义干扰。为了打破这一障碍，我们引入了一种测试时进化范式。通过将教师引导的潜在对齐与自监督的下一个用户话语预测任务相结合，以初始状态为基础进行持续改进，该框架成功克服了冷启动挑战，并实现了无标签的终身个性化。在长期对话基准测试上的大量实验表明，ThinkFlow显著优于现有的记忆系统，在长时间的多会话交互中提供了高度个性化和上下文准确的响应。

articles.title: Can LLMs Follow the Pulse of a Crisis? Evaluating Crisis Sentiment in Bangladesh's July Uprising
articles.abstract: Crisis sentiment analysis is especially challenging for low-resource languages such as Bangla, where language, context, and public reaction shift rapidly. We introduce UNRESTSENT200K, a Bangla crisis sentiment dataset with approximately 200K Facebook and YouTube comments from the July-August 2024 Bangladesh uprising. The dataset covers five event-aligned phases, from early escalation and internet blackout to regime transition and a later flood crisis. Each comment is linked to its parent post, enabling evaluation with and without discourse context. All comments are annotated through a fully human process involving 14 native Bangla-speaking annotators and senior validation, achieving substantial agreement (kappa = 0.73, alpha = 0.71) and 94.2% blind-audit agreement. We benchmark fine-tuned encoders, prompted LLMs, and LoRA-tuned LLMs. Results show that parent-post context consistently improves performance, while temporal shift across phases causes large performance drops. Strong LLMs perform well, but still struggle with sarcasm, implicit political references, and phase-dependent meaning. UNRESTSENT200K provides a benchmark for studying context-aware and temporally robust sentiment analysis in low-resource crisis discourse. UNRESTSENT200K is available at https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT200K/
articles.titleCn: LLMs能否把握危机脉搏？评估孟加拉七月起义中的危机情绪
articles.abstractCn: 危机情绪分析对于孟加拉语等低资源语言尤其具有挑战性，因为语言、语境和公众反应变化迅速。我们介绍了UNRESTSENT200K，这是一个包含约20万条Facebook和YouTube评论的孟加拉语危机情绪数据集，这些评论来自2024年7月至8月孟加拉国的起义事件。该数据集涵盖了与事件对应的五个阶段，从早期升级和互联网断网到政权过渡以及后来的洪水危机。每条评论都与其父级帖子相关联，从而能够在有无话语语境的情况下进行评估。所有评论都通过一个完全由人进行的过程进行标注，涉及14名母语为孟加拉语的标注员和高级验证，达到了高度的一致性（kappa = 0.73，alpha = 0.71）和94.2%的盲审一致性。我们对微调编码器、提示式LLM和LoRA微调LLM进行了基准测试。结果表明，父级帖子语境始终提升性能，而不同阶段之间的时间变化导致性能大幅下降。强大的LLM表现良好，但仍难以处理讽刺、隐含的政治指涉和阶段依赖的意义。UNRESTSENT200K为研究低资源危机话语中的语境感知和时序鲁棒性情绪分析提供了基准。UNRESTSENT200K可在https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT200K/获取。

articles.title: PaperDoctor: Evidence-Grounded and Actionable Feedback for Scientific Papers in Progress
articles.abstract: Autoresearch agents are reshaping the research ecosystem, but they can also let flawed claims enter the literature at scale. Human advisors catch such issues in drafts through careful, traceable feedback, yet advisor-style assessment requires extensive manual effort and does not scale. To shift automated paper assessment from a judge to a diagnostician, we introduce PaperDoctor, an agent framework for pre-submission feedback with three key innovations. First, a holistic hierarchical framework evaluates writing, layout, references, code, theory, prior work, and experiments through three layers: L1 surface screening, L2 typed verifiers that route each claim to the appropriate evidence, and L3 reproducers that rerun experiments by priority. Second, each finding contains an observation, a pointer to specific evidence such as a sentence, equation, or code line, and a revision suggestion, making critiques auditable and actionable. Third, PaperDoctor selectively rebuilds and reruns experiments based on claim importance and compute budget, surfacing reproducibility gaps and quantitative limitations that are invisible from the manuscript alone. We evaluate PaperDoctor on 30 in-progress papers, yielding 70.6% agreement and all positive holistic scores, and on 40 manuscripts across machine learning, natural science, and social science, covering human- and AI-authored papers with code. Overall, PaperDoctor produces more auditable feedback than human and other agentic reviewers, pairs critiques with concrete suggestions by design, and complements dimensions often overlooked by human reviewers. We also develop an interactive interface that lets authors browse findings grounded in their paper. PaperDoctor reframes automated paper assessment as diagnosis rather than verdict, taking a concrete step toward AI advisors for more rigorous AI-assisted scientific discovery.
articles.titleCn: 论文医生：为进行中的科学论文提供基于证据的可行反馈
articles.abstractCn: 自研代理正在重塑研究生态，但它们也可能大规模地将有缺陷的声明引入文献。人类顾问通过细致、可追溯的反馈在草稿中捕捉这些问题，但顾问式评估需要大量人工工作且无法扩展。为将自动论文评估从裁判转变为诊断师，我们引入了PaperDoctor，这是一个用于提交前反馈的代理框架，包含三项关键创新。首先，一个整体分层框架通过三层评估写作、排版、参考文献、代码、理论、先前工作和实验：L1表面筛选、L2类型化验证器将每个声明路由到适当证据，以及L3可复现器按优先级重运行实验。其次，每个发现包含一个观察结果、指向具体证据（如句子、方程式或代码行）的指针以及一个修订建议，使评论可审计且可操作。第三，PaperDoctor根据声明重要性和计算预算选择性地重建和重运行实验，揭示仅从手稿中无法看到的可复现性差距和定量限制。我们在30篇进行中的论文上评估了PaperDoctor，获得70.6%的协议一致性和所有积极的整体评分，并在机器学习、自然科学和社会科学领域的40篇手稿上进行了评估，涵盖人类和AI撰写的带代码论文。总体而言，PaperDoctor比人类和其他代理评审员产生更多可审计的反馈，通过设计将评论与具体建议配对，并补充人类评审员常忽略的维度。我们还开发了一个交互式界面，允许作者浏览基于其论文的发现。PaperDoctor将自动论文评估重新定义为诊断而非裁决，朝着实现更严谨的AI辅助科学发现的人工智能顾问迈出了具体一步。

articles.title: The Role of Implicit and Explicit Demographic Signals in Large Language Model-based Student Assessment
articles.abstract: Large Language Models are now common in student assessment, but we know little about how student demographics affect their use. Sometimes, considering student demographics may be necessary -- for example, to improve readability for users with lower educational levels. However, it also risks being a cause of discrimination, e.g., when assigning lower scores to students from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. We set up controlled prompts to test 1) explicit demographic effects, where we mention demographic details directly, and 2) implicit effects, where we use conversation history as a demographic signal. We test these settings in three tasks: Automated Essay Scoring, Formative Feedback, and Metalinguistic Question Answering. We test six state-of-the-art LLMs on these tasks. In both explicit and implicit cases, the models pick up on demographic cues and can change their scoring, feedback, and answers accordingly. We find that LLMs frequently adjust the readability of feedback to education levels when these are explicitly mentioned. On the other hand, implicit conditions produce unpredictable biases, such as in question answering, where responses from lower-education levels receive lower sentiment scores. Our results provide clear evidence of demographic sensitivity in LLMs for educational assessment tasks.
articles.titleCn: 基于大型语言模型的学生评估中隐式和显式人口统计信号的作用
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型现在已广泛应用于学生评估，但我们对其如何受学生人口统计特征影响知之甚少。有时，考虑学生人口统计特征可能是必要的——例如，为了提高对教育水平较低用户的可读性。然而，这也存在成为歧视原因的风险，例如，在给来自社会经济地位较低背景的学生打较低分数时。我们设置了受控提示来测试1）明确的人口统计效应，其中我们直接提及人口统计细节，以及2）隐含效应，其中我们使用对话历史作为人口统计信号。我们在三个任务中测试这些设置：自动作文评分、形成性反馈和元语言问答。我们在这些任务上测试了六种最先进的语言模型。在明确和隐含的情况下，模型都能捕捉到人口统计线索，并相应地改变其评分、反馈和答案。我们发现，当明确提及教育水平时，语言模型经常调整反馈的可读性以适应教育水平。另一方面，隐含条件会产生不可预测的偏见，例如在问答任务中，来自教育水平较低的回答会获得较低的 sentiment 分数。我们的结果表明，语言模型在用于教育评估的任务中具有对人口统计敏感性的明确证据。

articles.title: Autoformalizing Argumentative Material Inferences
articles.abstract: Natural language arguments are compelling before they are formally explicit. A premise supports a claim through defeasible warrants, background commitments, and exception conditions that the text leaves implicit. However, formal verification requires the opposite. Making such arguments machine-checkable requires constructing the missing commitments, not only translating given sentences into logic. Construction, however, carries a risk that translation does not: a system free to add premises can make any claim provable, and a formally valid proof may assert the claim outright, prove it without the original premise, or establish more than the claim itself. We address this problem by formulating autoformalization for argumentative material inference as guard completion, in which non-monotonic material support is turned into monotonic formal inference relative to an explicitly constructed guard set. A completion is accepted only when its proof both passes the theorem prover and survives contrastive tests of premise dependence and claim selectivity. We implement this formulation in GUARD, a neuro-symbolic framework in which LLMs construct and formalize candidate guards, Isabelle/HOL verifies the resulting theories and returns step-level feedback for iterative refinement, and the system abstains when no faithful completion can be reached. Our empirical results on Debatepedia and ARCT using different LLMs demonstrate that GUARD yields significant improvements in verified-faithful (+35.3, +32.9 points) and substantial reductions in leakage (-25.9, -21.9 points) over the state-of-the-art LLM-driven theorem proving approach. Moreover, we show that the symbolic soft critique and the explicit assumption layer account for most of these gains, with the soft critique also improving the initial validity of the elicited context and reducing the number of iterations required for successful verification.
articles.titleCn: 自动形式化论证材料推理
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言论证在形式明确之前具有说服力。前提通过文本留下的隐含的不可抗辩的保证、背景承诺和例外条件来支持论断。然而，形式验证要求相反。使此类论证机器可检查需要构建缺失的承诺，而不仅仅是将给定的句子翻译成逻辑。然而，构建却带有翻译所没有的风险：一个可以自由添加前提的系统可以使任何论断可证明，并且一个形式有效的证明可能直接断言该论断，无需原始前提即可证明它，或者建立比论断本身更多的内容。我们通过将论证性材料推理的自形式化表述为守卫完成来解决此问题，其中非单调的材料支持被转换为相对于明确构建的守卫集的单调形式推理。只有当其证明既通过定理证明器又能通过前提依赖性和论断选择性的对比测试时，才接受一个完成。我们在GUARD中实现了这种表述，GUARD是一个神经符号框架，其中LLM构建和形式化候选守卫，Isabelle/HOL验证生成的理论并返回用于迭代细化的步骤级反馈，当无法达到忠实完成时系统会弃权。我们在Debatepedia和ARCT上使用不同的LLM进行的实证结果表明，与最先进的LLM驱动的定理证明方法相比，GUARD在验证忠实度方面显著提高（+35.3，+32.9分），并在泄漏方面大幅减少（-25.9，-21.9分）。此外，我们表明，符号软批评和显式假设层解释了这些大部分收益，其中软批评还提高了所引出背景的初始有效性，并减少了成功验证所需的迭代次数。

articles.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs
articles.abstract: Open-weight language models publish the strings their chat templates use to mark turns, roles and tool results, which the tokenizer maps back to the reserved identifiers the model obeys. Anyone who controls text in a prompt can therefore write a turn boundary indistinguishable from one the serving stack wrote. We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems rely on. We propose nameless tokenization, which leaves the control entries with a reserved identifier and no surface string, so the content encoder cannot emit one and message content reaches the model unaltered. Across five tokenizer families it reproduces the standard token stream exactly on attack-free data and lifts accuracy on a probe of delimiter-bearing text from 8.5% to 59.9%, where sanitizers lose it. Separating a delimiter's appearance from its identifier shows the identifier matters little against a bare task instruction, but carries most of a forged tool result and most of any forged turn once the system message tells the model to treat user content as data.
articles.titleCn: 无名称分词：一种无损的标记器级防御，用于抵御开放权重大型语言模型中的控制标记伪造
articles.abstractCn: 开放权重语言模型会发布它们聊天模板中用于标记回合、角色和工具结果的字符串，这些字符串会被分词器映射回模型遵循的保留标识符。因此，任何控制提示中文字的人都可以编写一个与服务器堆栈写入的回合边界无法区分的回合边界。我们审计了256个已部署的聊天分词器。所有分词器都可伪造，而通常推荐作为修复措施的标志仍然有56.6%的可伪造性，因为它忽略了代理系统依赖的工具和推理标记。我们提出了无名称分词，它将控制条目保留为具有保留标识符且没有表面字符串，因此内容编码器无法发出一个字符串，消息内容以未修改的形式到达模型。在五种分词器家族中，它在无攻击数据上精确地复现了标准分词流，并将分隔符文本探测的准确率从8.5%提高到59.9%，而清理程序会丢失准确率。将分隔符的外观与其标识符分离表明，在纯任务指令面前，标识符几乎无关紧要，但在系统消息告诉模型将用户内容视为数据后，标识符承载了大部分伪造的工具结果和大部分伪造的回合。

articles.title: Target-Language Generation in Multilingual Models: Activation Steering and Optimal Control
articles.abstract: Ensuring that multilingual language models generate coherent text in a specific target language is a major issue in multilingual language modeling. We develop an optimal control method for target-language text generation as well as a framework for evaluating the quality of generated text in terms of language adherence, linguistic coherence, and semantic coherence. We find that the proposed method performs at least as well as the prominent difference-in-means activation steering method for the majority of models tested, with substantially less hyperparameter tuning required.
articles.titleCn: 多语言模型中的目标语言生成：激活引导与最优控制
articles.abstractCn: 确保多语言语言模型在特定目标语言中生成连贯文本是多语言语言建模中的一个主要问题。我们开发了一种针对目标语言文本生成的最优控制方法，以及一个用于评估生成文本在语言遵循性、语言连贯性和语义连贯性方面的质量框架。我们发现，所提出的方法在大多数测试模型中表现至少与突出的均值差异激活引导方法一样好，且所需的超参数调整大大减少。

articles.title: HUMAID-NER: A Disaster Tweet Dataset for Joint Named Entity Recognition and Event Classification via Uncertainty-Weighted Multitask Learning
articles.abstract: Rapid extraction of structured information from social media is important for humanitarian response, yet existing disaster tweet resources mainly provide document-level category labels without span-level entity annotations. We introduce HUMAID-NER, the first named entity recognition dataset built on the HumAID benchmark, containing 60,000 English disaster tweets annotated in BIO format across ten operationally motivated entity types and yielding approximately 175,000 labelled entity spans. Annotations are generated through a reproducible three-stage hybrid pipeline combining a spaCy transformer model, disaster-domain EntityRuler patterns, and structured regular expressions with priority-based overlap resolution. We also propose a joint multitask learning framework that performs disaster-specific named entity recognition and humanitarian event classification using a shared RoBERTa-large encoder. To reduce task conflict during joint training, the model uses homoscedastic uncertainty weighting with learnable task parameters and a two-stage training schedule that freezes the lower 18 of 24 encoder layers in the second stage. On the HUMAID-NER validation set, the proposed system achieves NER span micro-F1 of 0.841 and classification macro-F1 of 0.761 simultaneously. A real-time web dashboard demonstrates end-to-end deployment. The dataset, models, and pipeline code are released to support reproducibility and future crisis informatics research.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Published in The Asian Bulletin of Big Data Management, Vol. 6, No. 1, pp. 138-152, 2026
articles.titleCn: HUMAID-NER：一种用于联合命名实体识别和事件分类的不确定性加权多任务学习灾害推文数据集
articles.abstractCn: 从社交媒体快速提取结构化信息对于人道主义救援至关重要，然而现有的灾害推文资源主要提供文档级别的类别标签，而没有跨度级别的实体标注。我们介绍了HUMAID-NER，这是第一个基于HumAID基准构建的命名实体识别数据集，包含60,000条英文灾害推文，采用BIO格式标注了十种操作驱动型实体类型，产生了约175,000个标注实体跨度。标注通过一个可重复的三阶段混合流程生成，该流程结合了spaCy transformer模型、灾害领域的EntityRuler模式以及具有优先级重叠解决的结构化正则表达式。我们还提出了一种联合多任务学习框架，该框架使用共享的RoBERTa-large编码器执行灾害特定命名实体识别和人道主义事件分类。为了在联合训练过程中减少任务冲突，模型采用具有可学习任务参数的同方差不确定性加权，以及一个分两阶段进行的训练计划，在第二阶段冻结24个编码器层中的前18层。在HUMAID-NER验证集上，所提出的系统同时实现了0.841的NER跨度微观F1和0.761的分类宏观F1。一个实时网络仪表板展示了端到端的部署。数据集、模型和流程代码已发布，以支持可重复性和未来危机信息学研究。

articles.title: Verbalizing Subliminal Learning Effects Using Text Optimization
articles.abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in which a distillation dataset transmits traits from the teacher model that are not legibly encoded in the dataset itself. This introduces a new challenge for model development and creates new risks from data poisoning. In this work, we use text optimization to detect subliminal learning effects and describe them as legible prompts. Subliminal learning from a prompted teacher motivates our approach. We observe that this is a special case of context distillation and leverage this observation to show that, in theory, the prompted subliminal learning dataset identifies the teacher's prompt. We reduce recovering this prompt to a text optimization problem and present a method to approximately solve it. Our method, SALVE (Search-Aided Latent Verbalization), optimizes a soft prompt, queries the same model to verbalize it as text, and uses beam search to make the verbalization reliable. In the standard subliminal learning setting, SALVE reliably recovers legible prompts that name the teacher's trait, while common text optimization methods fail to do so. In addition, we find that there are settings in which SALVE recovers the teacher's trait from a dataset even when subliminal learning fails, but that modifying student training to improve context distillation can create subliminal learning effects. We lastly show that SALVE detects subliminal learning effects in three additional settings: (1) mixtures of subliminal learning data and unrelated data, (2) data generated when the teacher is biased via activation steering, and (3) subsets of real preference data selected via Logit-Linear Selection. Overall, our results deepen our understanding of subliminal learning and present SALVE as a method to proactively detect subliminal learning effects.
articles.titleCn: 通过文本优化来表述潜意识学习效应
articles.abstractCn: 潜意识学习是一种现象，其中精炼数据集通过传递教师模型中未在数据集中明确编码的特质。这为模型开发带来了新的挑战，并创造了数据污染的新风险。在这项工作中，我们使用文本优化来检测潜意识学习效应，并将其描述为可读的提示。从提示教师模型中获得的潜意识学习启发了我们的方法。我们观察到这是一种上下文精炼的特殊情况，并利用这一观察表明，理论上，提示的潜意识学习数据集识别了教师的提示。我们将恢复此提示的问题简化为一个文本优化问题，并提出了一种近似解决方法。我们的方法SALVE（搜索辅助潜在语言化）优化一个软提示，查询相同的模型将其语言化为文本，并使用束搜索来确保语言化的可靠性。在标准的潜意识学习设置中，SALVE可靠地恢复了对教师特质的命名提示，而常见的文本优化方法无法做到这一点。此外，我们发现即使在潜意识学习失败的情况下，SALVE也能从数据集中恢复教师的特质，但修改学生训练以改善上下文精炼可以创建潜意识学习效应。最后，我们展示了SALVE在三种额外设置中检测到潜意识学习效应：(1) 潜意识学习数据和无关数据的混合；(2) 教师通过激活引导产生偏见的生成数据；(3) 通过Logit-Linear选择选出的真实偏好数据子集。总的来说，我们的结果加深了我们对潜意识学习的理解，并将SALVE呈现为一种主动检测潜意识学习效应的方法。

articles.title: Lit3R: Retrieve-Relate-Read for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Scientific Literature
articles.abstract: We describe tus-nlp's Lit3R (Retrieve-Relate-Read) system for LitTraceQA, a shared task for literature-grounded question answering that requires systems to retrieve relevant papers, identify supporting evidence, and generate answers. Lit3R combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) components without task-specific training. The retriever iteratively combines BM25-based sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based verification, and complements retrieval based on the question with paper-to-paper expansion. The reader first identifies supporting evidence within individual papers and then synthesizes evidence across papers to produce the final answer and evidence trace. On the official test set, our system ranked 4th on the leaderboard. Our code is available at https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa.
articles.comment: Accepted at GroundLM 2026, an EMNLP 2026 Workshop LittraceQA
articles.titleCn: Lit3R：用于基于证据的科学文献问答的检索-关联-阅读方法
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了tus-nlp的Lit3R（检索-关联-阅读）系统，该系统用于LitTraceQA任务，这是一个基于文学内容的问答共享任务，要求系统检索相关论文、识别支持证据并生成答案。Lit3R结合了现成的检索、重排序和大语言模型（LLM）组件，无需针对特定任务进行训练。检索器通过迭代结合基于BM25的稀疏和密集检索、交叉编码器重排序以及基于LLM的验证，并根据问题对检索结果进行论文到论文的扩展。阅读器首先在单个论文中识别支持证据，然后跨论文综合证据以生成最终答案和证据轨迹。在官方测试集上，我们的系统在排行榜上排名第四。我们的代码可在https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa获取。

articles.title: Disrupted Companionship: A Risk Assessment Framework and Cross-Platform Quantitative Analysis of Psychosocial Responses to AI Companion Disruptions
articles.abstract: AI companions can provide meaningful relationships, yet these relationships remain vulnerable to platform-initiated changes. We study AI companion disruptions: platform changes that alter or terminate users' ongoing companionship with an AI. We compile 30 disruption events across major platforms, develop a taxonomy of six disruption types, identify three broad reasons for disruption, and propose a risk-assessment framework comprising four dimensions: relational discontinuity, population vulnerability, communication deficit, and transition-support deficit. Using longitudinal Reddit data, we estimate community-level psychosocial responses with a hierarchical Bayesian interrupted time-series model incorporating predictive controls. Across events, disruption onset was associated with immediate increases in anxiety, stress, suicidal expression, and grief activation, with relational discontinuity and transition-support deficit being associated with more adverse immediate responses across several outcomes. Our findings provide a cross-platform characterization of AI companion disruptions, quantitative evidence of their psychosocial impacts, and a prospective framework for assessing their potential risks before implementation.
articles.titleCn: 中断的陪伴：AI陪伴中断引发的社会心理反应风险评估框架与跨平台定量分析
articles.abstractCn: AI伴侣可以提供有意义的情感联系，但这些联系仍易受到平台发起的变化的威胁。我们研究了AI伴侣的干扰现象：即平台改变或终止用户与AI的持续伴侣关系。我们收集了30个主要平台上的干扰事件，开发了一个包含六种干扰类型的分类体系，确定了干扰的三种主要原因，并提出了一个包含四个维度的风险评估框架：关系中断、群体脆弱性、沟通缺陷和过渡支持缺陷。利用纵向Reddit数据，我们采用分层贝叶斯中断时间序列模型（并加入预测控制变量）估算了社区层面的心理社会反应。在所有事件中，干扰发生时与焦虑、压力、自杀表达和悲伤激活的即时增加相关，其中关系中断和过渡支持缺陷与多种结果的更不利的即时反应相关。我们的研究为AI伴侣干扰提供了跨平台的特征描述，为其心理社会影响提供了定量证据，并建立了一个在实施前评估其潜在风险的框架。

articles.title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech
articles.abstract: Counterspeech (CS) - direct responses that counter online Hate Speech (HS) using reasoning and alternative viewpoints - has emerged as an alternative to content removal. Current automatic CS generation methods, however, frequently produce generic, ineffective replies that fail to target the implicit stereotypes behind HS. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel scope-conditioned generation framework that explicitly integrates structured stereotype characteristics into Large Language Models prompts. We validate our approach on a novel, human-curated dataset annotated in English, Italian, and Spanish. Extensive evaluations show that stereotype-conditioned prompting substantially outperforms generic baselines across all three languages, obtaining significant gains in factuality, specificity, cogency, and effectiveness for both explicit and implicit implied stereotypes.
articles.titleCn: 解构刻板印象：基于范围条件生成的有效多语言反话语
articles.abstractCn: 反言论（CS）——通过推理和替代观点直接反驳网络仇恨言论（HS）的回应方式——已成为内容删除的替代方案。然而，当前自动生成反言论的方法经常产生通用且无效的回复，无法针对HS背后的隐性刻板印象。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种新颖的范围条件生成框架，将结构化的刻板印象特征明确地整合到大型语言模型的提示中。我们在一个新颖的、人工标注的英语、意大利语和西班牙语数据集上验证了我们的方法。广泛的评估表明，刻板印象条件提示在三种语言中均显著优于通用基线，在针对显性和隐性刻板印象方面，在事实性、具体性、说服力和有效性上均取得了显著提升。

articles.title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation
articles.abstract: Platform abuse campaigns conceal redirection instructions with emojis, homophones, character decomposition, and redundant symbols, then route users through disguised links to services associated with pornography, fraud, gambling, or illicit transactions. Existing benchmarks evaluate obfuscated text and risky webpages separately, obscuring how target recovery affects downstream evidence acquisition. We introduce RiskChainBench, pairing 3,600 synthetic token-text restoration inputs from 600 source sessions with 600 corresponding human-labeled local web environments. A model first restores the message, operational intent, and destination; the same underlying model then acts as a VLM-driven web agent that investigates the correctly associated website and produces a frozen, evidence-cited risk report without message-side semantics or domain-reputation cues. We score restoration and correct-routing web investigation separately and compose them offline by applying the frozen primary-entry prediction as a gate to the same Task 2 result. Human labels determine task correctness, while a fixed multimodal evidence judge assesses faithfulness, sufficiency, completeness, and consistency. Across ten models, Entry Top-1 ranges from 35.2% to 95.2% and web decision accuracy from 26.3% to 62.8%; the leading systems differ across entry recovery, full reconstruction, website decisions, and fine-grained typing. Execution failures account for 31.9% of web runs, whereas post-decision type errors account for only 0.9%, identifying stable exploration and risk judgment as the principal bottlenecks. We release the benchmark, protocol, and resettable local sandbox.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures; 17-page supplementary material included as an ancillary PDF
articles.titleCn: RiskChainBench：一个用于混淆平台消息恢复和证据导向网络调查的基准
articles.abstractCn: 平台滥用活动通过使用表情符号、谐音字、字符分解和冗余符号隐藏重定向指令，然后将用户引导至与色情、欺诈、赌博或非法交易相关的伪装链接。现有的基准分别评估混淆文本和风险网页，模糊了目标恢复如何影响下游证据获取的过程。我们引入了RiskChainBench，将来自600个源会话的3,600个合成令牌-文本恢复输入与600个相应的本地人工标记网页环境配对。模型首先恢复消息、操作意图和目的地；随后，同一底层模型作为由视觉语言模型驱动的网页代理，调查正确关联的网站，并生成一份冻结的、证据引用的风险报告，不包含消息侧语义或域声誉线索。我们分别对恢复和正确路由的网页调查进行评分，并通过将冻结的初始入口预测作为门控应用于相同的任务2结果进行离线组合。人工标签决定任务正确性，而一个固定的多模态证据裁判员评估忠实度、充分性、完整性和一致性。在十个模型中，入口Top-1准确率范围从35.2%到95.2%，网页决策准确率从26.3%到62.8%；领先系统在入口恢复、完整重建、网站决策和细粒度分类方面存在差异。执行失败占网页运行的31.9%，而决策后的类型错误仅占0.9%，确定稳定探索和风险判断是主要瓶颈。我们发布了基准、协议和可重置的本地沙盒。

articles.title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or copyrighted knowledge while preserving general utility. Existing methods often leave residual knowledge in intermediate representations, which can still be recovered. To address this, we propose Cascade, a hierarchical recoverability control framework that minimizes the internal identifiability of target knowledge. Cascade combines three complementary controls: path-level routing to suppress privacy-associated activation routes, representation-level compression to reduce geometric separability, and decoding-level intervention to limit residual recovery. Experiments on TOFU, MUSE-News, and WMDP, including robustness tests with query reformulation and extraction-style prompts, show that Cascade effectively reduces recoverability while maintaining stable model utility.
articles.titleCn: 级联：大型语言模型去学习的分层可恢复性控制
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的卸载学习对于移除敏感或受版权保护的知识，同时保留通用功能至关重要。现有方法往往在中间表示中留下残留知识，这些知识仍可被恢复。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Cascade，一个分层可恢复性控制框架，该框架最小化了目标知识的内部可识别性。Cascade结合了三种互补的控制方法：路径级路由以抑制与隐私相关的激活路径，表示级压缩以减少几何可分离性，以及解码级干预以限制残留恢复。在TOFU、MUSE-News和WMDP上的实验，包括使用查询重写和提取式提示的鲁棒性测试，表明Cascade在有效降低可恢复性的同时，保持了模型功能的稳定性。

articles.title: Reduplicative constructions in Mandarin: Socio-emotional profiling through distributional semantics
articles.abstract: Mandarin Chinese has two productive reduplicative constructions that repeat either two-character base words or their constituents (e.g., `in good health', `discuss a bit'). Their varied meanings have been described as realizing plurality, valence coloring, sound symbolism and pragmatic functions. The aim of this study is twofold. A first goal is to clarify whether it is possible to come to a more precise understanding of the variegated semantics of Mandarin reduplication by using word embeddings from distributional semantics. A second goal is to explore how useful embeddings are for understanding the details of a semantically complex word-formation process. We show that the embedding space recovers the semantic and grammatical properties of reduplications previously identified in the literature, validating Tencent embeddings for morphological investigation. Semantic profiling revealed that reduplicative constructions are often strongly represented on multiple dimensions. The two patterns exhibit clear semantic and pragmatic differentiation in distributional space. Procrustes analysis clarified that the overall organization of the base-word space is largely preserved in the reduplication space, with local mismatches highlighting regions of discourse-pragmatic reorganization. Taken together, these results show that high-dimensional word embeddings can recover established linguistic generalizations, and capture the semantic versatility of Mandarin reduplication and constructional transparency.
articles.titleCn: 普通话中的重复结构：通过分布语义进行社会情感分析
articles.abstractCn: 普通话有两种能产性重叠结构，它们会重复双字词根或其组成部分（例如，“身体健康”、“讨论一下”）。这些结构多样的含义被描述为实现复数、价态着色、声音象征和语用功能。本研究旨在达成双重目标。第一个目标是阐明是否可以通过使用分布语义学的词嵌入，来更精确地理解普通话重叠的多样化语义。第二个目标是探索词嵌入在理解语义复杂的构词过程细节方面的作用。我们证明，嵌入空间恢复了文献中先前识别的重叠的语义和语法属性，验证了腾讯嵌入在形态学研究中的有效性。语义分析揭示，重叠结构在多个维度上通常具有强烈的表征。这两种模式在分布空间中表现出清晰的语义和语用差异。Procrustes分析表明，词根空间的整体组织在重叠空间中得到了很大程度的保留，局部不匹配突显了话语语用重组的区域。综合来看，这些结果表明高维词嵌入能够恢复已确立的语言学普遍规律，并捕捉普通话重叠和结构透明性的语义多样性。

articles.title: A Data-free Universal Prior over Syntactic Structures
articles.abstract: Probability is fundamental to theories of language comprehension, production, acquisition, and evolution, as well as to large language models. Existing theories estimate the probability of syntactic structures from language-specific data. Whether part of this probability structure can arise independently of language-specific experience remains unknown.
